blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate monocular depth estimation serves as a core enabler for single camera scene understanding. However, existing self-supervised monocular depth estimation methods generally suffer from the bottleneck of inefficient cross-scale information interaction and difficulty in balancing local and global spatial modeling. In this paper, we propose CMambaDepth, a self-supervised framework that achieves efficient multi-scale feature fusion and fine-grained contextual modeling via channel-wise selective state propagation. Specifically, Bidirectional Channel Mamba (Bi-CMamba) aligns encoder features across scales and enables bidirectional information exchange among ordered scale groups. Unidirectional Channel Mamba (Uni-CMamba) progressively aggregates decoder features and retains fine-grained scale groups through a group selection mechanism for subsequent fusion. Furthermore, a Hybrid Attention Module (HAM) is introduced to combine large-kernel local context and Manhattan self-attention for complementary spatial modeling. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves highly competitive performance. Specifically, our model achieves an AbsRel of 0.094 and an RMSE of 4.156 on KITTI, and an AbsRel of 0.140 on DDAD. In the zero-shot cross-dataset generalization test on NYUv2, it attains an AbsRel of 0.232, outperforming the baseline RA-Depth by 7.2%.
blocks.zh: 精确的单极深度估计是单镜头场景理解的核心助推器. 然而,现有的自我监督的单体深度估计方法一般都受到跨尺度信息互动效率低下和难以平衡当地和全球空间模型的瓶颈的影响。 在本文中,我们提出CMamba Depth,这是一个自我监督的框架,通过频道选择性的传播,实现高效的多尺度特性聚变和精细的上下文模型。 具体来说,双向通道Mamba(Bi-CMamba)统一了各种尺度的编码器功能,使订购的尺度组之间能够进行双向信息交流。 单向通道Mamba(Uni-CMamba)通过组合选择机制,逐渐聚合解码器特征,保留精细刻度尺度组,用于后续聚变. 此外,还引入了一个混合关注模块,将大内核局部环境与曼哈顿自我关注相结合,用于互补的空间建模。 实验结果表明,我们的方法取得了高度竞争性的业绩。 具体来说,我们的模型在KITTI上实现了0.094的AbsRel和4.156的RMSE,在DDAD上实现了0.140的AbsRel. 在NYUv2上的零射线跨数据集通用化测试中,它达到了0.232的AbsRel,比基线RA-Depth多7.2%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Monocular depth estimation underpins navigation and robotic perception. Supervised multi-scale learning [ 1 ] lays the foundation for label-free stereo reconstruction [ 2 ] and left-right consistency constraints [ 3 ] without depth labels. Monocular video training [ 4 ] , minimum reprojection, and auto-masking [ 5 ] extend the scope of self-supervised learning. SC-DepthV3 [ 6 ] addresses dynamic scenes, while DCPI-Depth [ 7 ] incorporates dense correspondence priors.
blocks.zh: 单体深度估计支撑了导航和机器人感知. 监督的多尺度学习[1]为无标签立体重建[2]和左右一致性约束[3]打下了基础,没有深度标签. 独家影视训练[4],最小重排,自动化妆[5]扩大了自我监督学习的范围. SC-DepthV3 [6] 处理动态场景,而DCPI-Depth [7] 包含密集的函证前传.

blocks.en: Feature aggregation plays a central role in preserving geometric structures for monocular depth estimation. MonoViT [ 8 ] models global context with vision transformers, and RA-Depth [ 9 ] learns resolution-adaptive feature representations. TSUDepth [ 10 ] explicitly models temporal uncertainty. However, most existing approaches still suffer from inefficient cross-scale feature fusion, lacking a selective mechanism to adaptively integrate complementary cues while mitigating inherent scale ambiguity. This gap therefore motivates the exploration of selective cross-scale interactions.
blocks.zh: 地物聚合在为单体深度估计保留几何结构方面发挥着中心作用. MonoViT [8] 具有视觉变换器的模型全球背景,RA-Depth [9] 学习解析度-适应性特征表示. TSU深度[10]明确模拟时间不确定性. 然而,大多数现有方法仍然受到效率低下的跨规模特征组合的影响,缺乏一种选择机制,以适应性地整合互补的提示,同时减轻固有的规模模糊性。 因此,这一差距促使人们探索选择性的跨规模互动。

blocks.en: Mamba [ 11 ] makes state space parameters input-dependent. VMamba [ 12 ] and MambaDepth [ 13 ] extend this mechanism to vision and depth, respectively. Yet existing visual Mamba models fail to jointly capture fine-grained local details and model global context within a single compact block. To address this issue, we design HAM that combines large kernel attention (LKA) [ 14 ] and Manhattan self-attention (MaSA) [ 15 ] on the aligned scale-specific decoder features.
blocks.zh: Mamba [11] 使状态空间参数依赖输入. VMamba[12]和Mamba深度[13]分别将这一机制扩大到视觉和深度。 然而,现有的可视Mamba模型未能在一个单一的紧凑块内共同捕捉精细的局部细节和全球模型。 为了解决这一问题,我们设计了HAM,将大型内核注意力(LKA)[14]和曼哈顿自留心(MaSA)[15]结合在一致的标尺专用解码器特征上.

blocks.en: 2.1 Overall architecture
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 总体结构

blocks.en: Fig. 1 shows the overall architecture of CMambaDepth. Built on RA-Depth [ 9 ] , the network adopts a five-scale HRNet18 encoder [ 16 ] and a ResNet18 pose encoder [ 17 ] used only during training. Bi-CMamba exchanges information bidirectionally across encoder scales. Four Uni-CMamba stages fuse decoder features in a coarse-to-fine order, with three HAM instances deployed in parallel between the first two stages. Finally, a depth head produces the map from the fused features.

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets and implementation
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集和执行

blocks.en: On KITTI [ 18 ] , our model is trained for 35 epochs with a batch size of 11 and an initial learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . On DDAD [ 19 ] , the model is trained for 60 epochs with a batch size of 4. The initial learning rates of the pose encoder, depth encoder, and depth decoder are set to 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , and 6 × 10 − 5 6\times 10^{-5} , respectively. For NYUv2 [ 20 ] , the model trained on KITTI is directly evaluated in a zero-shot cross-dataset setting without any fine-tuning. Our model is implemented in PyTorch, and all experiments are conducted on a single RTX 4090 GPU. We adopt Adam [ 21 ] as the optimizer and initialize both the depth and pose encoders with ImageNet-pretrained weights [ 22 ] . The data augmentation strategy and remaining loss settings follow RA-Depth [ 9 ] . We adopt four error metrics, namely AbsRel, SqRel, RMSE, and log-depth RMSE (RMSElog), together with three accuracy metrics δ 1 \delta_{1} , δ 2 \delta_{2} , and δ 3 \delta_{3} under the ratio thresholds 1.25, 1.25 2 1.25^{2} , and 1.25 3 1.25^{3} .

blocks.en: 3.2 Quantitative comparisons
blocks.zh: 3.2 定量比较

blocks.en: Table 1 provides Comparisons on KITTI, DDAD, and NYUv2. On KITTI, CMambaDepth (Ours) reduces the baseline AbsRel and RMSE by 2.1% and 1.4%, reaching 0.094 and 4.156, respectively. With only 10.89 M parameters, our model already achieves a lower RMSE than MonoViT [ 8 ] .On DDAD, CMambaDepth (Ours) improves over RA-Depth on all seven metrics. Compared with TransDSSL (2022) [ 23 ] , AbsRel and RMSE decrease from 0.151 and 14.350 to 0.140 and 13.550, respectively. IntrLessMonoDepth (2025) [ 24 ] attains a slightly lower RMSE, whereas our method is superior on AbsRel and SqRel. Overall, our method achieves competitive results on both datasets with a compact model, which we attribute to the efficient selective cross-scale fusion performed by Bi-CMamba and Uni-CMamba, and the low-cost contextual modeling provided by HAM.
blocks.zh: 表1列出 关于KITTI、DDAD和NYUv2的比较。 在KITTI上,CMamba深度(我们的)将基线AbsRel和RMSE分别减少2.1%和1.4%,分别达到0.094和4.156. 由于只有10.89M参数,我们的模型已经实现了比MonoVit [8]. On DDAD, CMamba Depth(我们的)在所有七个度量衡上都比RA-Depth改进. 与TransDSSL(2022)[23]相比,AbsRel和RMSE分别从0.151和14.350降至0.140和13.550. IntrLessMono Depth (2025) [24] 获得略低的RMSE, 而我们的方法优于AbsRel和SqRel. 总的来说,我们的方法在两个数据集上都取得了竞争结果,采用了紧凑的模型,我们将此归因于Bi-CMamba和Uni-CMamba进行的高效率的选择性跨规模聚变,以及HAM提供的低成本背景模型。

blocks.en: Under the zero-shot setting without any fine-tuning on NYUv2, our method reduces AbsRel, SqRel, and RMSE over RA-Depth, achieving to relative reductions of 7.2%, 16.1%, and 7.2%, respectively. Meanwhile, CMambaDepth (Ours) outperforms both MonoViT (2022) [ 8 ] and DCPI-Depth (2025) [ 7 ] on all seven metrics. These results demonstrate the improved generalization and support the effectiveness of selective cross-scale fusion and contextual modeling.
blocks.zh: 在NYUv2的零射线设定下,我们的方法将AbsRel,SqRel和RMSE分别比RA-Depth减少7.2%,16.1%和7.2%. 同时,CMamba深度(我们的)在所有7个度量衡上都优于MonoViT(2022)[8]和DCPI-深度(2025)[7]. 这些结果显示,选择性跨规模聚变和背景建模的普及性有所改进,并支持其有效性。

blocks.en: 3.3 Component ablation and qualitative analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 构成部分分析和定性分析

blocks.en: Table 2 presents the ablation results for different combinations of the proposed components. Bi-CMamba and Uni-CMamba reduce SqRel from the baseline value of 0.632 to 0.624 and 0.621, respectively, while HAM reduces RMSE from 4.216 to 4.171. When all three components are combined, the model attains the best overall results. These results verify the functional complementarity of the two module families and the effectiveness of their joint modeling.
blocks.zh: 表2列出拟议组成部分不同组合的削减结果。 Bi-CMamba和Uni-CMamba将SqRel分别从基线值0.632降至0.624和0.621,而HAM则将RMSE从4.216降至4.171. 如果将所有三个组成部分合并起来,该模式将取得最佳的总体结果。 这些结果证实了两个单元的功能互补及其联合建模的有效性。

blocks.en: 4 CONCLUSION
blocks.zh: 4. 结 论

blocks.en: CMambaDepth combines bidirectional encoder-scale interaction, unidirectional decoder fusion, and hybrid attention. Quantitative comparisons on KITTI and DDAD, zero-shot cross-dataset generalization on NYUv2, and component ablations support the proposed design. Our model achieves 0.094 KITTI AbsRel and reduces NYUv2 AbsRel by 7.2% relative to RA-Depth. In future work, we will explore multi-frame image sequences as input to strengthen generalization, and further reduce computational cost.
blocks.zh: CMamba Depth结合了双向编码器规模的相互作用,单向解码器聚变,以及混合注意力. 对KITTI和DDAD进行定量比较,对NYUv2进行零镜头跨数据集概括化,组件拼接支持拟议的设计. 我们的模型实现了0.094 KITTI AbsRel,并且相对RA-Depth将NYUv2 AbsRel减少了7.2%. 在未来的工作中,我们将探索多帧图像序列作为投入,以加强概括,并进一步降低计算成本.
